A1.justification: Both PDFs contain the same K2VAE research work. All 22 pages in each version, including equations, figures, tables and Appendices A-C, support reliable comparison.

before.justification: v1 reports original forecasting experiments, component ablations, runtime and memory measurements, and forecast visualizations in Section 4 and Appendix C.

after.justification: v3 retains these original empirical results, including benchmark comparisons, ablations, efficiency measurements and appendix forecast examples.

M1.justification: Section 3 retains the same token embedding, local-plus-global Koopman operator, residual Integrator, KalmanNet, Gaussian decoder and learning objectives. Equation alignment changes do not alter the procedure.

E1.justification: Both versions evaluate the same eight short-term and nine long-term dataset settings. Tables 1 and 7 and Appendix C.1 retain identical coverage, including the distinct short-term and long-term dataset variants.

E2.justification: Table 2 retains the same 11 baselines, while long-term Tables 3, 9 and 10 retain the same 10. D3VAE remains included in the short-term comparison and absent from those long-term tables. Efficiency comparators are also unchanged.

E3.justification: Forecast horizons, context lengths, Gaussian heads for point baselines, CRPS/NMAE metrics, 100-sample CRPS estimation and testing procedures remain identical in Section 4.1 and Appendix C.1-C.4.

E4.justification: The same Koopman-operator variants, Integrator connections and component-removal ablations appear in Tables 4-6 and 12-14. Efficiency analyses and the forecast showcases in Appendix C.7 are also retained unchanged.

E5.justification: Both versions report five independent retraining/evaluation runs, the same mean-and-standard-error captions, and different-seed information in Tables 9-10. The 95% interval displays in Figures 5-7 are unchanged.

E6.justification: All forecasting scores, uncertainty values, ablation results, efficiency measurements and forecast examples are unchanged. For example, Table 3 reports K2VAE Electricity-L CRPS of 0.057 ± 0.005 at horizon 720 in both versions.

T1.justification: The mathematical definitions, Theorems 3.1-3.2 and their Appendix A proofs are unchanged. Differences in displayed equations concern spacing and alignment only.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction contributions and conclusion retain the same claims about Koopman linearization, Kalman uncertainty refinement, reduced error accumulation, forecasting accuracy and efficiency.

C2.justification: Explanations of nonlinearity, numerical instability, component contributions and efficiency remain unchanged. The discussions of applicability, unavailable experimental results and future directions introduce no new qualifications or limitations.

D1.justification: Appendix C.4 retains identical hyperparameter-search, software, A800 hardware, Adam and batch-size/OOM details. Code/data access information and the baseline repository links in Table 8 are unchanged.

R1.justification: Appendix B.1 adds citations to AimTS, AutoCTS+, Miao et al.'s replay-based continuous learning framework and Zhao et al.'s dynamic-graph forecasting work, while removing Wu et al.'s tunnel-leakage study. These limited citation changes do not revise K2VAE's substantive positioning.

P1.justification: v3 consolidates duplicate Triformer references, updates citation suffixes, corrects capitalization of several reference names and updates version/date metadata. The narrative, explanations and section organization otherwise remain unchanged.

P2.justification: Some equations on pages 4-5 and 15 are horizontally realigned, and bibliography and Appendix B text reflow. Figures 1-7 and Tables 1-14 retain their content, structure and placement.

improvement.justification: v3 makes limited citation and typography adjustments, including consolidating a duplicate reference. The method, proofs, experimental evidence, interpretations and reproducibility information remain substantively identical, so these editorial changes do not establish a meaningful overall quality difference.
